rule: Band lifted, goal is slow recovery. Entered by resting limit at mid rather than crossing the spread. Sides dealt by seed.
seed: 20261010 (sha256 of seed|market_slug; shuffles the deal order)
note: REBUILT at 08:10 after Kiley asked where the football was. The 07:30 version had 4 picks and NO college football on a Saturday with 94 upcoming games, because ladder.rungs() silently discards any rung quoted wider than 4c and the CFB book was still thin that early -- 20% of its near-even markets are STILL above that filter at 08:00. The same command with the same seed now returns the CFB picks. card.py now prints per-league coverage so a league contributing nothing is stated rather than invisible.

research.what_went_wrong: Not the --max-per cap, which works correctly. The builder dropped every CFB rung on spread width and said nothing, so a Saturday card went out with no football. I had seen a CFB pick appear at --max-per 1 and vanish at --max-per 2 and did not chase it. The fix is the coverage report: the failure was silence, not arithmetic.
research.no_nfl_today: 0 upcoming NFL -- correct, the NFL plays Sunday. MLB has 1 upcoming game with nothing in band.
research.fee: Searched 2026-10-10: 0.0695 is the TAKER coefficient; published schedules agree makers pay zero and earn a rebate near 0.0125, which would put maker break-even at 50c at 49.69%, BELOW a coin flip. NOT VERIFIED -- polymarket.com and docs.polymarket.com are blocked here and the gateway exposes no maker/taker field. Taker remains the default in fees.py and in this card's numbers.

claude.basis: resting limit at mid -- no edge claimed
claude.rung_why: Posted at MID as a resting limit, not crossed: crossing costs $4.43 of EV per $100 at zero edge against $3.48 resting at mid, and if the fee is a taker fee as the published schedules say, a filled maker order pays zero. Mid rather than the bid because bid fills are adversely selected (24/51 = 47.1% against 50.8% for the unfilled). If nobody sells into it before kickoff this is NO BET -- no stake, no fee, excluded by fills.py.
